message: ウェイトレスの苦行

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. I see, it says here that criminals have a habit of returning to the scene of the crime.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is what is known as a homing instinct.」

name: Paqy
message: 「There ain't no such habit, dumbass.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it a non-habit, then?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Prier has tons of delicious food, so it's naturally appealing, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't be stupid. You're dead wrong if you think all demons are like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Appetite is just one of the three great desires of the world.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The three great desires of the world... Mr. President. What are those?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, let's see... appetite, sleep, and after that is--aah!」
I-I can't say the rest of this in front of a girl, it's too embarrassing!

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well... sun... bathing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It says 'lust' right here, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Daaah!! A girl shouldn't be saying embarrassing things like that!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it something to be embarrassed about?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's... uh...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lust, huh... Just what kind of incredible desire could it possibly be!?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Geez, this is all your fault, Paqy!\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ya see, lust is when the deep parts of your body get all tingly and itchy. 'Oh, hold me!! Oh, I'm gonna hold ya!!' Like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If that is the case, my body is quite familiar with it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With Jeeves... quite often...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What in the world... To think the two of you had that kind of relationship」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sleeping together whenever one of you has a scary dream... Indeed, it really is an embarrassing thing, just as the President says\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you not have any sexual desire, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's... a secret\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No fair~~! Please tell me~~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... If he's hiding it, that means he's got it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a splendid leading question!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... maybe a little... Hey, now is not the time to be talking about sexual desire!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「What are you guys fooling around about in public, nyan\s09」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, well, if it isn't Pasta-san」

name: Pasta
message: 「I've been asking what your order is for a while now, nyan. Hurry up and decide, nyan」
If only we had the money, we wouldn't have to do something this embarrassing, though...

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm still deciding~~\s01」

name: Pasta
message: 「You guys are the only customers left, yet you keep loitering around so I can't close up shop, nyan!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is also part of our Student Council activities」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte! Shh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For-profit enterprises must obey public-interest organizations absolutely」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nothing pisses me off more than being lectured by a petty civil servant, nyan. If you want to drink water, go to the athletic field, nyan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That doesn't taste good unless you drink it after exercising, you know」

name: Pasta
message: 「Always whining about this and that!! Stop getting in my way already, nyan!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It can't be helped, then. Well, while we wait, I shall help out with the waitressing」

name: Pasta
message: 「Huh!? T-That would be wildly appreciated, nyan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In the meantime, I'll leave the check to you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood」

name: Pasta
message: 「Don't go deciding things on your own, nyan!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no need to hold back. Carrying a little water is no trouble at all」

name: Pasta
message: 「You say that, and then you'll trip halfway and cause a huge disaster, just making more places to clean, nyaaan!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm not you, Pasta-san. There's no way I'd make a blunder like that」
Now then...

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaa!! The water cooler broke, nyaaa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! President, please help us!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, lend me your toolbox」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't have one!!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Those guys... giving my sweet Pasta trouble... I'll never forgive them!」
「Those guys... giving my sweet Pasta trouble... I'll never forgive them!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Hold on!? Pasta's in a pinch here. If I capture her heart right now...」
「Hold on!? Pasta's in a pinch here. If I capture her heart right now...」

name: Ardin
message: 「Does that mean she'll definitely go, 'Lord Ardin, I love you, nyaaan\s04' and we'll be all lovey-dovey!!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Uooooh, I'm the only one who can save Pasta now!! Hyaaah, let's do thiiiis!」
